summary: Frontend-only regression test for the 'Cadastrar processo' button visibility bug fix on /processos Novo Processo dialog. All acceptance criteria pass on both desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844). The submit via form= attribute correctly creates a process end-to-end.

issues: A11y warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — non-blocking but should add DialogDescription for accessibility.

critical_code_review_comments: Add <DialogDescription> to Novo processo dialog to satisfy Radix a11y warning.

The client Select first option is '+ Cadastrar novo cliente' which triggers inline required fields; if user opens the dropdown by accident they hit HTML5 'Please fill out this field' popup. Consider moving the inline creation to a distinct affordance or making the inline fields non-required until user starts typing there.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 real process (CNJ 2009418876-11.2026.8.26.0100) tied to client 'Fagner dos Santos' via UI as part of regression flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 'save button off-screen in Novo processo dialog' is verified fixed. DialogContent uses max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col; form has overflow-y-auto flex-1 min-h-0; submit button lives outside form in a fixed footer with border-t and submits via form='process-form' attribute — this works and creates the process (POST /api/processes → 200).
rca of the issue: Original: growing dialog contents (CNJ, inline client creation, PDF upload, situação, financial section w/ cobranças) pushed the submit button below the viewport with no scroll on DialogContent. Fix moved the submit outside the form/scroll area into a sticky footer, form submits via HTML form= attribute. Verified visible at y=643.5/800 (desktop) and y=673.5/844 (mobile).
